answer: No claim swims alone; each rests in its claimant's lagoon. A warden sails a voyage across that lagoon, draws one older sibling claim at random, and three blind strangers re-check it against its sealed reference within an hour. A failed sibling is a poisoned portfolio: its ripple kills the new claim too — void, fee burned, barred a week. Honest work costs five cents and a clean history; 1,000 fakes pay $50 and must keep all 1,000 portfolios real.
